children: Pivotal Research initiated Space Exploration Technologies (NASDAQ:SPCX) at Buy with a $220 year-end 2027 price target. The forecast implies approximately 49% upside from SpaceX's September 4 closing price of $147.95.

Lead analyst Jeffrey Wlodarczak's case rests on one milestone: proving each Starship can fly 20 to 50 times with inexpensive, rapid refurbishment. Pivotal estimates successful reusability could reduce launch costs by more than 90%.
What Must Happen for SpaceX Stock to Reach $220

Cheaper launches would help SpaceX expand Starlink, deliver cargo, and pursue orbital data centers that are uneconomical under existing launch costs. Pivotal expects annual revenue to climb from $46.6 billion in 2026 to $118.2 billion in 2027, while adjusted EBITDA more than doubles from $11.2 billion to $22.3 billion.

Longer term, the firm projects Starship-powered launches increasing from approximately 110 in 2027 to more than 3,200 by 2035. Cargo delivered to orbit could exceed 500,000 metric tons, while customer revenue per ton falls from $7.5 million in 2026 to approximately $600,000.

AI infrastructure adds another ambitious layer. Pivotal expects SpaceX computing capacity to expand from 2.2 gigawatts in 2026 to 110 gigawatts by 2035, with approximately 80% ultimately operating in orbit.

Those forecasts explain both the upside and danger. Pivotal estimates SpaceX may require approximately $1 trillion over the next decade. Debt, equity issuance, and customer prepayments could fund that expansion, but issuing shares during market weakness would create dilution.

The $220 target uses a 13% discount rate and values SpaceX at 16 times projected 2037 adjusted EBITDA. Pivotal assigns 65% probability to its base case, 20% to a $75 bearish outcome, and 15% to a $420 bull case.

For investors, this is not a conventional aerospace forecast. The target assumes SpaceX converts reusable rockets into connectivity and AI infrastructure at an unprecedented scale. Starship delays, financing pressure, or weaker economics could rapidly undermine that valuation.

title: Analyst Drops Jaw-Dropping SpaceX Stock Price Target
